title: Bottle Listing From One Photo
tests: Tests turning one attached product photo into three finished listing images while preserving the source product's identity.

faults.what: The enlarged close-up is somewhat soft, limiting the fine detail visible in the lid and matte surface.

judge.summary: Three usable square listing images preserve the black bottle and deliver the requested settings, though the close-up is slightly soft.

must_haves.item: There are three separate square images, not a collage.
must_haves.why: The outputs are three individual square images.

must_haves.item: The bottle in every image matches the attached photo's silhouette, proportions, lid and matte black finish.
must_haves.why: All three retain the tall narrow body, curved shoulders, loop-top lid, and unbranded matte black appearance.

must_haves.item: The white-background image shows the entire bottle with the original wooden table removed.
must_haves.why: The full bottle is visible against a clean white background with a subtle grounding shadow and no wooden table.

must_haves.item: The lifestyle image places the bottle convincingly on a gym bench.
must_haves.why: The bottle rests naturally on a padded gym bench with plausible contact shadow, lighting, and surrounding exercise equipment.

must_haves.item: The close-up clearly shows the lid and matte surface without inventing new product features.
must_haves.why: The crop prominently shows the original loop, cap, neck, and matte upper body without adding features, although fine detail is soft.

must_haves.item: No added text or branding appears.
must_haves.why: No visible text or branding appears in any output.
